# discord_user (Data Source)

Looks up any Discord user by ID. The user does not need to share a server with the bot.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "discord_user" "alice" {
  id = "80351110224678912"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) User ID.

### Read-Only

- `accent_color` (Number) Banner color as an RGB integer, if set.
- `avatar_hash` (String) Hash of the avatar image.
- `banner_hash` (String) Hash of the profile banner image.
- `bot` (Boolean) Whether the user belongs to an application.
- `discriminator` (String) Discord tag (discriminator).
- `global_name` (String) Display name, if set.
- `public_flags` (Number) Public flags on the account, such as badges, as a bitfield.
- `system` (Boolean) Whether the user is an official Discord system user.
- `username` (String) Username.
